html:
Sapa is a foggy city with famous landscapes, simple and rustic villages and many unique festivals, especially in the fall, Sapa brings visitors a golden color, looking from afar like a carpet spread along the mountainside.

Sapa’s ripe rice season starts from September and October, depending on the weather each year. However, the rice starts from green and gradually turns yellow from the month to the end of October. If you are planning to travel to Sapa in the ripe rice season, you should go at this time to enjoy the beauty of the Northwest’s golden season.

The most beautiful places to see Sapa’s golden season

Muong Hoa Valley

Coming here, visitors not only immerse themselves in the beauty of the flowers, but also admire the beauty of the golden terraced fields in the fall. If you are a fan of virtual life in Sapa’s golden season, come here in the fall to capture beautiful pictures.

Ta Phin Village

Although not far from the town center, this place offers visitors the most interesting experiences, a peaceful rustic beauty, if you do not like the hustle and bustle, Ta Phin Village is the destination for you.

Y Linh Ho Village

Located about 3 km from the center of Sapa town, but this place has its own beauty, with famous landmarks, to get away from the hustle and bustle, visitors should come here to admire the wild beauty that Sapa brings to visitors.

What to eat when traveling to Sapa during the ripe rice season.

Traveling to Sapa at any time of the year, visitors can not only visit, enjoy or immerse themselves in the natural beauty, but also enjoy delicious dishes such as salmon hotpot, sturgeon, cat cabbage, five-color sticky rice or grilled skewers…

So if you are planning to go on a tour to Sapa, contact Vietlook Travel immediately to experience the most interesting things, especially in the fall when Sapa welcomes visitors with its cool weather, golden terraced fields, and unique festivals, visitors will be immersed in the sound of the flute, and experience the life of the people in the Northwest highlands.
